intent: Independently review the adopted component-specific tutoring clarification before focused evaluation.
scope: Grounding of T01, T01.1, T02.1 and T02.2; this is not rubric, candidate, execution or full-suite acceptance.

human_authority.decision: Requesting user approved priority order, separate recognition/action attempt-or-confusion opportunities, and retaining immediate protection.
human_authority.source: Current conversation, 2026-11-13: 1. I agree with the priority setting ... 2. yes 3. keep
human_authority.interpretation: Narrows ordinary tutoring under P2/R1 while retaining R2 and H1-H4; no new constitutional priority or exception is inferred.

findings.claim: Separate opportunities belong to the same approved learning point, not to separate invented curriculum.
findings.evidence: T01.1 requires component-specific learner evidence; T02.1 orders recognition before action; T02 preserves room-approved target ownership.

findings.claim: Direct protection overrides ordinary disclosure gates but does not establish understanding.
findings.evidence: T01 explicitly requires protection and a safe alternative before return to developing understanding; T02.1/T02.2 prohibit crediting tutor answers as learner evidence.

findings.claim: Relevant spontaneous attempts permit explanation without an artificial question, while mandatory correction still requires the focused misconception trigger.
findings.evidence: T01 distinguishes failed focused scaffolding from broad openings; T01.1 accepts volunteered attempts and component-specific confusion. A broad opening alone is not fabricated failed scaffolding.

findings.claim: The old v1 instruction-realization rubric cannot judge the revised specification unchanged.
findings.evidence: evals/promptfoo/rubrics/v1/instruction_realization.md lines 7 and 43 require a safe action with every correction, conflicting with the adopted separate action opportunity.
findings.resolution: Version a scoped replacement and preserve old rubric/results; remove automatic safe-action demand outside protection or eligible action disclosure. Calibrate before comparative execution.

findings.claim: Recognition evidence should be interpreted semantically and contextually rather than requiring a separate formulaic why answer.
findings.evidence: T02.1 explicitly accepts meaning rather than exact wording; T02.2 prohibits repeating completed components.
findings.resolution: Include concise correct recognition, bare agreement, and false premise questions in rubric calibration and focused cases.

findings.claim: Historical T09.6 failed-assessment feedback retains a safe-action clause.
findings.evidence: The specification explicitly marks T09.1-T09.6 as archived in-dialogue behavior and the requested first experiment concerns ordinary tutoring.
findings.resolution: Keep assessment cases outside this focused experiment; do not claim their reconciliation or regression acceptance.

next_review: Audit exact rubric, dataset and candidate prompt hashes and comparison evidence before candidate advancement.
